description: This file defines the `absl::any` type, a type-safe container for holding any copy-constructible type, similar to C++17's `std::any`. It includes implementation details, external dependencies, and functions for creating, casting, and managing `absl::any` objects.

classes.name: absl::any
classes.description: A type-safe container for storing a copy-constructible value of any type, with support for type erasure, cloning, and type identification.

methods.name: make_any
methods.description: Constructs an `absl::any` object holding a value of type `T` with provided arguments.

methods.name: any_cast
methods.description: Casts an `absl::any` to a specific type, throwing `absl::bad_any_cast` if the type does not match.
